description:
Lists the issuing authorities available through this tool, with metadata such as jurisdiction and issuing authority.

When to use: When you need issuing authorities for a known iso. Pass optional portal name or issuing authority only to narrow that list. When not: Do not call without an iso from list_jurisdictions. Skip if you already have this issuing authority list for the same iso and filters. Empty data means the iso is outside the subscription, or no issuing authority matched.

Parameters: iso (required) is a jurisdiction code from list_jurisdictions (e.g. BE, or US_CA for a state). portal_name and issuing_authority are optional. issuing_authority must match one issuing authority exactly. With limit, next_id parameters to paginate the results.

Behavior: Read-only SELECT; does not create, update, or delete records, files, or credentials. The only effect is a database read. Auth: tools/call requires OAuth 2.0 or a Bearer token (401 if missing, invalid, revoked, or no active subscription). Rate limits: none at the MCP layer; safe to retry. Not cached; each call reads current subscription and issuing authority data. Issuing authorities with total_links of 0 are omitted.

Returns: A list of issuing authorities matching the filters, with pagination information.

next_id.description: Next issuing authority ID to return

name: list_issuing_authorities

data.description: Issuing authorities in the requested jurisdiction that have crawled links; empty if none match.

limit.description: Maximum number of issuing authorities returned

next_id.description: Cursor ID for the next page, or null when there is no next page

total_count.description: Total number of matching issuing authorities
